final: WITH name_totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM name_totals), kept AS (SELECT nt.name, nt.total_points FROM name_totals AS nt CROSS JOIN threshold AS t WHERE nt.total_points > t.avg_total) SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_points) FROM kept) AS kept_total_points, (SELECT AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId JOIN kept AS k ON k.name = r.name WHERE res.laps IS NOT NULL) AS avg_laps, (SELECT AVG(k.total_points - t.avg_total) FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN threshold AS t) AS avg_excess_total
